# Jay Daftari

> Jay Daftari is a computer scientist and Gen AI engineer trained in AI and machine learning at New York University (MS, Computer Engineering). Jay builds agentic AI systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM tooling, most recently for legal teams at Lina Law and Wequity.

Portfolio: https://jaydaftari.github.io/

## Experience

- Lina Law, Gen AI Engineer (May 2026 to Oct 2026, remote): built Claude agents and an MCP server with 60+ tools that read client emails and case files, then draft and review contracts on the firm's own Word templates, cutting turnaround from weeks to hours; built a real-time collaborative document editing system with concurrency support and Claude integration, used daily by the firm's lawyers; added OCR for scanned PDFs (Mistral OCR on Vertex AI) and moved uploads straight to cloud storage, raising the file size limit from 32 MB to 300 MB; built agent observability tooling that replays each AI run step by step (its reasoning and every tool call).
- Wequity, Gen AI Engineer (Feb 2026 to May 2026, remote): built Nora's Smart Drafting engine on Claude Opus 4.6 (GPT-5.4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro fallbacks), auto-filling legal templates from client files with a cited source for every field; hardened the drafting pipeline (FastAPI, Cloud Run) with parallel extraction, per-file failure isolation and Slack alerts; cut first paint by 80% (12.2s to 2.4s) and raised Nora's Lighthouse performance score from 55 to 68; fixed Postgres bloat by moving to UUIDv7 keys and dropping 34 unused indexes.
- Vicktoria AI, Gen AI Engineer (Sep 2025 to Apr 2026, New York City): launched vicka.ai, a chat and voice AI coach, self-hosting a fine tuned model with vLLM on RunPod GPUs that activates only 4B parameters per token; built the RAG pipeline that bases every answer on the founder's methodology (BGE embeddings, pgvector); built a hands-free voice mode with self-hosted Kokoro TTS (Python, FastAPI) and ElevenLabs; automated deployment with GitHub Actions to AWS EC2 through OIDC and SSM; prototyped a talking-avatar service on Modal H100 GPUs.
- NYC Department of Environmental Protection, Summer Graduate Intern (Jun 2025 to Aug 2025, New York City): developed and re-engineered enterprise-level applications supporting NYC DEP's contracts, procurements, and payment systems, valued at over $3 billion in transactions annually, using Web Services, jQuery, ASP.NET, and VB.NET; implemented end-to-end ETL processes with MS SQL Server, Python, Power BI, DAX Studio, and Report Viewer.
- New York University, Course Assistant (Jan 2025 to May 2025): open-source course development in Python and C++.
- IDFC First Bank, Application Engineer (Mar 2022 to Aug 2024, Bengaluru): React and React Native apps impacting 20M customers; UPI and video KYC features; 97% unit test coverage; Grafana and Prometheus monitoring.
- VIT Center of Advanced Data Science, Research Intern (Jul 2021 to Aug 2021, Chennai): explainable machine learning for water quality (90% accuracy, LIME and SHAP).
- Premware Services India LLP, MEAN Stack Developer (Feb 2021 to Mar 2021, Surat): real-time backend for Surati Taxi.

## Selected projects

- Auto Safety: an AI tool that watches live NYC traffic cameras and forecasts street risk (Next.js 15, RAPIDS)
- MyNextDate (Hacklytics 2026, team of four): a date planner that scores dates with an LLM (Llama 3.1 on Groq) and recommends the next one by vector similarity search (React, FastAPI, Actian Vector AI DB); https://devpost.com/software/mynextdate
- Shelclub: an editorial magazine platform with a writers' desk and an editor review workflow (Next.js 15, Payload CMS)
- Efficient Hybrid Autoregressive Transformer: a faster HART text-to-image generation pipeline (PyTorch, CUDA)
- Gradient Analysis for Edge Deployment: gradient statistics that guide pruning and gradient prediction (PyTorch)
- Efficient Fine-Tuning of RoBERTa with LoRA (Python)
- NYC MTA Ridership Dashboard: analytics and forecasting for 5+ years of NYC subway ridership (PySpark, Streamlit)
